plausibility_notes: Laboratory supports targeted glass poisoning and transfer involving a common fragrance miniature. Original source is supported by consistent residues rather than an exclusive chemical match. Universal favor stock makes container possession insufficient for identity.

Plaster and cloth independently corroborate Al and Brie handling the glass exterior but do not prove poisoning. Their physical contact remains real opportunity, so neither is cleared by this distinction.
Negative tests on PROP, brush-water and FIXER eliminate those recovered objects as source containers, not Dada, Vincent, or a presumed studio-bottle owner as killers. Each could use the favor too.
Justin's favor in map sleeve becomes as relevant as others' kit/pouch/desk favors. No evidence singles him out; his prior threat about a wall is not murder evidence.
Discarded miniature lacks owner/fingerprint; final identity will require timing, observation, confession inconsistency or another discriminator. Chemical mechanism does not establish actor.

If poison was transferred from an antique bottle into a perfume bottle, emptying/rinsing and dosing require time and safe handling; current story provides no method or observation beyond residue. This need not be a plot hole but remains underexplained.
